RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male panel increases the risk of unconscious affinity bias, but panel composition alone does not prove discrimination. For laboratory director positions, selection committees frequently weigh formal management credentials and broad leadership experience more heavily than higher academic qualifications like a PhD. 

Do not raise gender bias immediately, as an unsupported accusation can damage professional relationships. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your written feedback. Once received, examine whether the rationale relied on objective, job-related criteria. If the feedback is evasive, inconsistent with the job specification, or suggests pretext—or if institutional hiring policies mandated a diverse panel—consult HR, a union representative, or an employment advisor before formally escalating.
